messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Error rate spike detected on /internal/embeddings/batch (500s > 8%) · paging oncall

incident-bot: Pager assigned -> maya (oncall). Incident ID: INC-2026-0423-EMB

maya: I'm on it. Initial triage: are we seeing customer-facing 5xx or just internal pipeline failures? @support-raj can you surface any customer tickets?

support-raj: 2 customers opened tickets reporting search rerank failures ~10:12 UTC. Both say results empty or 502 from our UI service. No P0 escalations yet.

maya: thanks. Priority = high. Sanjay, can you look at the embedder worker logs and batch endpoint metrics?

sanjay: pulling logs now. I've started a live query on prod: `select count(*) from embed_errors where ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'`

claire: FYI we had a deploy to reranker-service ~09:55 UTC (non-breaking config tweak). Not sure if related.

lucy: I'm seeing a recurring error line in embedder logs: `vector_length_mismatch: expected 2048 got 1536` for many batches. Example: 
```
2026-04-23T10:11:37Z ERROR embedder-worker batch_id=ab12 size=64 error=vector_length_mismatch expected=2048 actual=1536 upstream=tokenizer-2
2026-04-23T10:11:37Z INFO job aborted batch_id=ab12
```

sanjay: same. Error rate spikes align with those vector length mismatch entries. Looks like certain tokenization path produced shorter vectors, causing downstream reranker to reject batch.

maya: timeline check:
- 09:55 UTC: reranker-service config change (Claire)
- 10:05 UTC: increased traffic due to scheduled campaign
- 10:10 UTC: embedder batch errors start (vector len mismatch)
- 10:12 UTC: support tickets appear
- 10:14 UTC: orchestrator retries start, amplifying errors

claire: the config change was a switch to new tokenizer version (tokenizer-2) behind a feature flag; rollout was 09:55 with 10% traffic. I didn't expect cross-service consumers to assume vector size.

maya: action items (live mitigation):
1) disable tokenizer-2 rollout immediately (Claire)
2) route traffic away from problematic batch endpoint -> use small-batch endpoint for affected tenants (Sanjay / Ops)
3) increase retries/backoff on orchestrator to avoid thundering (Ops-bot suggested)
4) collect full failed batch payloads for RCA (Lucy)

claire: disabling rollout now (`featurectl rollback tokenizer-2 --env=prod`). Will update in 30s.

ops-bot: exec: `route-modify --service embedder --from pool/batch64 --to pool/batch8 --filter=tenant:affected` -> accepted

sanjay: routing changes applied. Confirming error rate dropping on /internal/embeddings/batch (checking metrics)... error rate reduced to ~1.2% after routing and rollback.

support-raj: informed the two affected customers and opened priority support threads. Mentioned mitigation and ETA for full fix.

maya: good. For RCA we need:
- full timeline + root cause hypothesis (tokenizer change caused vector size change)
- list of affected tenants and request ids
- link to failing batch payloads and logs
- postmortem draft with blameless contributors and follow-ups

lucy: uploading logs for failed batches to /internal/s3/incidents/INC-2026-0423-EMB/failures/ (links below)
- s3://redwood-prod/incidents/INC-2026-0423-EMB/failures/ab12.log
- s3://redwood-prod/incidents/INC-2026-0423-EMB/failures/ab13.log

sanjay: aggregated request ids for one example tenant: `req_ids = [r_2034, r_2035, r_2036]` — cross-ref to support threads.

maya: hypothesis checklist (in-thread) — mark status: open/in progress/closed
1) tokenizer-2 produced shorter embeddings (expected 2048 -> got 1536) -> IN PROGRESS (logs confirm)
2) reranker-service didn't validate vector length and crashed -> IN PROGRESS (errors show rejects)
3) orchestrator retry amplification made transient failures become customer-facing -> IN PROGRESS
4) monitoring lacked a vector-length alert -> OPEN

claire: agreed. We'll add a guard in tokenizer rollout process: require embedding-shape contract tests and smoke tests that validate vector size before traffic shift.

ops-bot: note: created incident ticket INC-2026-0423 and attached initial timeline.

product-alex: customer impact estimate? how many searches affected in 10:10-10:20 window?

sanjay: rough numbers: ~1.8k batch calls, ~150 tenants had >1 error, 2 tenants had visible UI errors. I'll produce the exact CSV of tenant,error_count.

maya: if anyone is handing off to next oncall, leave a clear status. I'm going to run the post-incident checklist and start a postmortem doc.

lucy: collected payloads show tokenization metadata: `tokenizer_version=tokenizer-2` and `embedding_dim=1536` for failed batches. Old batches tested under tokenizer-1 have `embedding_dim=2048`.

claire: immediate fix planned: pin tokenizer to tokenizer-1 for all traffic, add contract test to CI, and implement service-level vector-dim validation that rejects/auto-fixes mismatches with an early metric.

support-raj: sent customer update at 10:40 UTC: "We mitigated the issue and have a fix in progress; we'll follow up with root cause and timelines."

maya: handing off to @sanjay (next oncall) at 10:54 UTC — system stable, mitigation in place, follow-ups assigned. Leaving the thread for postmortem consolidation.

sanjay: taking over. Will collect final metrics and draft RCA. Noted follow-ups:
- add vector-dim alert (SLO team)
- rollout gating for tokenizer releases (claire + eng-ml)
- rollback playbook for batch endpoints (ops)

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Incident INC-2026-0423 marked mitigated at 10:54 UTC.

maya: thanks team. Postmortem draft to be linked in this thread when ready.

sanjay: attaching preliminary RCA doc link: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0423-rca (draft)

lucy: final note: saved failing batch payloads and a replay tool snapshot so we can reproduce locally with tokenizer-2.

product-alex: scheduling a follow-up meeting with customer success and eng to review timeline and compensations if needed.

maya: closing handoff.
